Al Jawhara Residences is a 29-storey residential building in JVT District 2, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai and this project was developed by Tiger Properties. Jumeirah Village Triangle is one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses. Each apartment in Al Jawhara Tower reflects a new direction of luxury and elegance in a location just minutes from major attractions.
